purpose: diagnose the prior two-roll sign reversal without adding model capacity or making a promotion claim

cohort.queries: every one of the 43 locally complete aligned frames exactly once

selection.correct_roll: hash-select three non-query frames from the query physical roll
selection.each_wrong_roll: hash-select three frames independently from each other physical roll
selection.pooled_wrong: hash-select three frames from the union of all other physical rolls
selection.content_retrieval_wrong: three nearest source-only frame descriptors from other physical rolls
selection.shuffled_roll: fixed count-preserving permutation of roll labels; select three frames assigned the query pseudo-roll

content_descriptor.features: linear-RGB channel mean/std plus Lab L percentiles 10/50/90 and Lab chroma mean/std
content_descriptor.standardization: robust median/IQR over the 43 source frames

strength_control.target_style: correct-roll mean Delta-E00 from query input

statistics.primary: per-query target Delta-E00 gain versus the strongest fixed control
secondary: raw and style-matched gain by physical roll
win rate versus every individual wrong roll
gain versus pooled-wrong, retrieval and shuffled-roll arms
association with location, scene_property and source-descriptor distance
statistics.cluster: physical roll, with query-frame resampling inside roll
statistics.minimum_replication: all four physical-roll point estimates must be positive for any renewed group-information hypothesis

decision.diagnostic_support: correct-roll is positive on all four rolls and remains positive against pooled, retrieval, shuffled and every wrong-roll control after source-only style matching
decision.nuisance_explanation: correct-roll loses to retrieval/pooled/shuffled or gain is explained by source descriptor/location/scene_property
decision.heterogeneous_or_unidentified: roll signs disagree, the four-roll cluster interval includes zero, or no single explanation replicates

claim_ceiling: Retrospective archive/scanner-specific mechanism diagnosis only; not stock truth, calibration, digital-to-film evidence or a fresh confirmatory result.
